messages:
Harper J.: opened PR to add a small CSV export example to the Console observability guide and to tweak a tracing-hook snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5102 :wave:
Ibrahim N.: nice. can you make the CSV example show the cost attribution column and a short note about per-token vs per-request costs? customers get confused.
Harper J.: yep. thinking one line above the table: 'Per-token items vary with average sequence length; per-request fees are fixed.' keep it short.
Zoë M.: saw the tracing-hook snippet uses `traceId` and the dashboard filter sample expects `trace_id`. can we standardize to `trace_id` (snake_case) across the new CSV and snippets?
Harper J.: will do. also the Node SDK snippet uses the old `tracing.enable()` call; SDK moved to `tracing.startSpan()` last quarter. I'll update and mention the SDK version.
Ibrahim N.: please add a parenthetical: '(requires SDK >= 2.3)' next to the snippet heading.
Harper J.: good call. I'll also replace one dangling link to /console/old-obsv with /console/observability (found during linkcheck).
Zoë M.: tiny UX ask  can we add an HTML anchor id="csv-cost" beside the table so PMs can link to the CSV example?
Harper J.: added anchor and a 1-line example filter for dashboards: `trace_id = "{{trace_id}}"`.
buildbot: docs CI run for PR #5102 succeeded (build 4934) :white_check_mark:
Ibrahim N.: pushed wording tweak on the cost sentence and fixed snake_case across CSV headers. left one nit about a code fence language tag.
Zoë M.: fixed the JS fence (javascript) and removed an extra trailing comma in the example CSV row.
Harper J.: final checklist: 1) squash lint bot commit 2) confirm SDK version text 3) merge after approvals. any objections to me merging today?
Ibrahim N.: all good from me.
Zoë M.: go ahead once squashed.
Harper J.: merging after squash, tagging #product-docs for visibility :sparkles:
__notes: Short Slack thread coordinating a docs PR: CSV export example, tracing-hook snippet migration, SDK version note, snake_case standardization, cost/latency clarification, anchor and link fixes, CI pass. Slack-style concise messages.
